subject: Follow-ups from #1268 (the PR search benchmark workflow) (#1317)
reason: The change modifies only CI and build tooling: the search-benchmark-pr.yml GitHub Actions workflow (runner label change, trusted checkout of CI scripts, cleanup of the checkout directory) and a new ci/install_deps.sh script that installs build dependencies and the GCC toolchain on Amazon Linux 2023. No valkey-search module source, command behaviour, replies, persistence, replication, or server-visible behaviour changes, so no scenario can exercise it and none is needed.
